Source: Colistin has become a critical antibiotic for fatal Gram-negative infections owing to the proliferation of multidrug-resistant carbapenemase-producing bacteria.
Luganda: Colistin ddagala eritta obuwuka erifuuse ery’omugaso ennyo ku bulwadde obw’omutawaana obutakyawulira ddagala olw’okwekubisaamu kwa bakitiiriya ezitakyawulira ddagala ery’enjawulo erya carbapenem.
Yoruba: Colistin ti di ògun apa kòkòrò tí ó ṣe pàtàkì púpọ̀ fún ìtọ́jú kòkòrò ìrànmọ́ni aṣàtakò Gram èyí tí ìwọ́pọ̀ àìṣeṣẹ́ fún ni mọ́ ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ògun apakoro àrun carbapenemase ṣe okùnfà.
Zulu: I-Colistin isiphenduke i-antibiotic yezifo ezi-Gram-negative ngenxa yokwanda kwamagciwane amelanan nemithi eyahlukene akhiqiza i-carbapenemase.
Hausa: Colistin ya zama maganin rigakafi mai mahimmanci ga ƙwayoyin cututtukan Gram-negative masu kisa saboda yawaitar yaɗuwar magunguna ƙwayoyin cuta masu jurewa carbapenemase.
Northern Sotho: Colistin e bile anthipayothiki ye bohlokwa ya go alafa diphetetšo tša Gram-negative tše di feletšago ka lehu ka lebaka la go tsenywa ga paketheria ye e tšweletšago carbapenemase ye e palelago go alafša ke dihlare tše ntši.
Amharic: ብዙ የመድሃኒት ተጋትሮ ያላቸውን ካርባፔኒማስ በሚያመርቱ ባክቴሪያዎች ምክንያት የሚከሰቱ የግራም-ኢንፌክሽኖችን ለመከላከል ኮሊስቲን በጣም ወሳኝ አንቲባዮቲክ ነው፡፡

Source: Thus, cheaper, faster, efficient and easier-to-use colistin diagnostics are required for clinical surveillance, diagnoses and therapeutics.
Luganda: Noolwekyo, enkebera za colistin ezitali za buseere, ezanguwa, ezikola obulungi era ennyangu okukozesa zeetaagibwa okukola okulondoola kw’ekisawo, okukebera n’okujjanjaba.
Yoruba: Fún ìdí èyí, ìlò colistin dínwó, ó ṣiṣẹ́ kánkán, ó múnádóko bẹ́ẹ̀ sì tún ni ó rọrùn láti lò fún àbojútó ìṣègùn, àwọn ìwádìí àìsàn bẹ́ẹ̀ ni ó tún ṣiṣẹ́ ìwòsàn.
Zulu: Ngakho, ukuxilonga nge-colistin okushibhile, okusheshayo kuyadingeka ukuqapha kwezempilo nokwelapha.
Hausa: Don haka, ana buƙatar bincikar cututtukan colistin mai rahusa da sauri da inganci da kuma sauƙin amfani don sa-ido na asibiti, bincikar cututtuka da kuma hanyoyin warkewa.
Northern Sotho: Se se ra gore, diphekolo tša colistin tša go se ture, tša go šoma ka pela le gabotse di a nyakega go dira tekolo ya tša kalafo, phekolo le kalafi.
Amharic: ስለዚህ ርካሽ፣ ፈጣን፣ በቀላሉ ጥቅም ላይ መዋል የሚችል እና ውጤታማ የኮሊስቲን ምርመራዎች ለክሊኒክ ክትትል፣ ምርመራ እና ህክምና አስፈላጊ ናቸው፡፡

Source: The sensitivity, specificity, major error (ME), very major error (VME), categorial agreement, essential agreement, turnaround time (TAT), average cost, and required skill for four colistin resistance diagnostics viz., CHROMagar COL-APSE, ComASP Colistin, MicroScan, and Colistin MAC Test (CMT) were evaluated against broth microdilution (BMD) using 84 Gram-negative bacterial isolates.
Luganda: Obusobozi bw’okulaba abalwadde, obusobozi bw’okulaba abatali balwadde, ensobi ez’amaanyi, ensobi ez’amaanyi ennyo, okukkaanya kw’ebibinja, okukkaanya okw’enkizo, obudde obumalibwa, ebisale, n’obukugu obwetaagisa okukozesa enkebera z’okumanyiira colistin za mirundi ena omuli, CHROMagar COL-APSE, ComASP Colistin, MicroScan, ne Colistin MAC Test (CMT) byekenneenyezebwa ku lupimo lwa broth microdilution (BMD) nga bakozesa ebika 84 ebya bakitiiriya ezitakyawulira ddagala.
Yoruba: Ìmọ̀sílára, pàtàkì, aṣìṣe gbòógì (ME), aṣìṣe gbòógì gan-an-ni (VME), àdéhùn ní pàtó, àdéhùn pàtàkì, àkókò àṣetán iṣẹ́ ní pàtó (TAT), ìdajì iye, àti ìmọ̀ tí ó nílò fún àyẹ̀wò ìtakora colistin mẹ́rin viz., ìgbéléwọ̀n wáyé fún CHROMagar COL-APSE, ComASP Colistin, MicroScan, àti Colistin MAC àyẹ̀wò (CMT) lẹ́gbẹ̀gbẹ́ pẹ̀lú broth microdilution (BMD) nípa lílo 84 kòkòrò àrùn Aṣàtakò Gram tí a dá yà sọ́tọ̀.
Zulu: Ukuzwela, ukuqondana, i-major error (i-ME), i-very major error (i-VME), isivumelwano sesigaba, isivumelwano esibalulekile, isikhathi sokuqeda (i-TAT), izindleko ezilinganisiwe, kanye nekhono elidingekayo lokuhlonza izifo okune okumelana ne-colistin okuyi-CHROMagar COL-APSE, i-ComASP Colistin, i-MicroScan kanye ne-Colistin MAC Test (i-CMT) kuhloliwe kuqhathaniswa ne-broth microdilution (i-BMD) kusetshenziswa ama-84 Gram-negative bacterial isolate.
Hausa: An ƙimanta ƙarfin da nau’in, babban kuskure (ME), babban kuskure sosai (VME), yarjejeniyar rukuni, yarjejeniya mai mahimmanci, lokacin juyawa (TAT), matsakaicin farashi, da kuma ƙwarewar da ake buƙata don gwajin juriya na colistin guda huɗu wato., CHROMagar COL-APSE da ComASP Colistin da MicroScan da kuma Gwajin Colistin MAC (CMT) a kan broth microdilution (BMD) ta amfani da keɓaɓɓun ƙwayoyin ciuta Gram-negative 84.
Northern Sotho: Go kwagala kudu, ka fao go ikgtheilego, phošokgolo (ME), phošokgolo kudu (VME), tumelelano ka magoro, tumelelano ye bohlokwa, nako ya phethagatšo (TAT), tshenyegelo ya bogareng, le bokgoni bjo bo nyakegago bja diphekolo tše nne tša go palela colistin ke gore., CHROMagar COL-APSE, ComASP Colistin, MicroScan, le Colistin MAC Test (CMT) di ile tša sekasekwa kgahlanong le broth microdilution (BMD) ka go šomiša diphapanyi tše 84 tša paktheria ya Gram-negative.
Amharic: ለትብነት ልዩነት ዋና ስህተት (ዋ.ስ) በጣም ከባድ ስህተት (በ.ከ.ስ)፣ የምድብ ስምምነት፣ ጠቃሚ ስምምነት እና የመልሶ መዞር ጊዜ (መ.መ.ጊ) አማካይ ወጪ፣ እና ለአራት የኮሊስቲን ተጋትሮ ያላቸው ምርመራዎች ማለትም፣ CHROማጋር፣ COL-APSE፣ ኮምASP ኮሊስቲን፣ ማይክሮ ቅኝት እና የኮሊስቲን MAC ሙከራ (ኮ.M.ሙ) ከብሮዝ ማይክሮዱሌሽን(ብ.ማ) አኳያ 84 ግራም-ኔጌቲቭ የባክቴሪያ ንጥሎችን በመጠቀም ተገምገማዋል፡፡

Source: A multiplex PCR (M-PCR) was used to screen all isolates to detect the presence of the mcr-1 to mcr-5 genes.
Luganda: PCR ekenga ebika eby’enjawulo (M-PCR) yakozesebwa okukebera ebika byonna okuzuula obulagabutonde bwa mcr-1 okutuuka ku mcr-5.
Yoruba: A ṣe àmúlò multiplex PCR (M-PCR) láti ṣe àyẹ̀wò gbogbo ìyàsọ́tọ̀ láti mọ bóyá jíìnì mcr-1 si mcr-5 wà.
Zulu: I-multiplex PCR (i-M-PCR) yasetshenziswa ukuhlola onke ama-isolate ukuthola ubukhona bezimpawufuzo ze-mcr-1 kuya kwi-mcr-5.
Hausa: An yi amfani da Multix PCR (M-PCR) don tantance duk keɓaɓɓu don gano ƙwayoyin gadon mcr-1 zuwa mcr-5.
Northern Sotho: Multiplex PCR (M-PCR) e šomišitšwe go lekola diphapantšhi ka moka ka nepo ya go utolla go ba gona ga ditšini tša mcr-1 go fihla go tša mcr-5.
Amharic: ብዜት ያለው ፖ.ሰ.ም (M-ፖ.ሰ.ም) ሁሉንም ንጥሎች ለመቃኘት እና ከ mcr-1 እስከ mcr-5ጂኖችን መኖር ወይም አለመኖር ለመለየት ጥቅም ላይ ውሏል፡፡

Source: A 15-point grading scale was used to grade the tests under skill, ease, processing time etc.
Luganda: Olupimo lw’ensonga olw’ennamba 15 lwakozesebwa okugera enkebera okusinziira ku bukodyo, obwangu, obudde obumalibwa n’ebirala.
Yoruba: Ìgbéléwọ̀n onípele 15 ni a lò láti ṣe ìgbéléwọ̀n lábẹ́ ọgbọ́n, ẹ̀rọ̀, iye àkókò iṣẹ́ àti bẹ́ẹ̀bẹ́ẹ̀ lọ.
Zulu: Isikali sokunika amaphuzu esinamaphoyinti ayi-15 setshenzoswa ukunika amaphuzu izivivinyo ngaphansi kwekhonao, ubulula, isikhathi sokwenza njll.
Hausa: An yi amfani da ma’auni mai maki 15 don tantance gwaje-gwaje a ƙarƙashin fasaha da sauƙi, lokacin sarrafawa da sauransu.
Northern Sotho: Sekala sa kelo sa dintlha tše 15 se ile sa šomišwa go lekola diteko ka fase ga bokgoni, bonolo, nako ya go šoma, bjalobjalo.
Amharic: የ 15-ነጥብ የውጤት መለኪያ፣ ለሙከራው ከአቅም፣ ከቅለት እና ከማስኬጃ ጊዜ አንጻር ውጤት ለመስጠት ጥቅም ላይ ውሏል፡፡

Source: mcr-1 was detected by both M-PCR and CMT in a single E. coli isolate, with other PCR amplicons suggestive of mcr-2, -3 and -4 genes being also observed on the gel.
Luganda: mcr-1 yakengebwa M-PCR ne CMT mu kika kya E. coli ekimu, nga PCR endala ziraga nti waliwo obulagabutonde bwa mcr-2, -3 ne -4 nabwo nga busangiddwa ku gel.
Yoruba: A ṣe àwári mcr-1 nínú M-PCR àti CMT nínú ẹyọ E. coli tí ó dá dúró pẹ̀lú àwọn amplicon PCR fi hàn pé jíìnì mcr-2, -3 àti -4 fi ara hàn lórí gel.
Zulu: I-mcr-1 yathoalakala ngakho kokubili i-M-PCR ne-CMT kwi-isolate eyodwa ye-E. coli, neamanye ama-PCR amplicon agigiyela ukubonakala kwi-gel kwezimpawufuzo ze-mcr-2, 3 kanye no-4.
Hausa: m-PCR da kuma CMT sun gano mcr-1 a cikin E. coli guda ɗaya, tare da wasu amplicons na PCR da suke nuna ƙwayoyin gado mcr-2, -3 da kuma -4 a kan jel.
Northern Sotho: mcr-1 e utollotšwe ke bobedi M-PCR le CMT ka go E. coli ya phapantšhi e tee , mola e le gore PCR amplicons tše dingwe di šišinya ditšini tša mcr-2, -3 le -4 le tšona di lemogilwe go jele.
Amharic: mcr-1፣ በሁለቱም M-ፖ.ሰ.ም እና ኮ.M.ሙ በአንድ የኢ-ኮላይ ንጥል ውስጥ የተገኘ ሲሆን  ሌሎች mcr-2፣ -3 እና -4 ጂኖችን የሚያመለክቱ  የፖ.ሰ.ም አምፕሊኮኖች ጄሉ ላይ ታይተው ነበር፡፡

Source: The sensitivity and specificity of CHROMagar COL-APSE, MicroScan, and ComASP Colistin, were 82.05% and 66.67%, 92.31% and 76.92%, and 100% and 88.89% respectively.
Luganda: Obusobozi bw’okulaba abalwadde n’obusobozi bw’okulaba abatali balwadde obwa CHROMagar COL-APSE, MicroScan, ne ComASP Colistin, bwali ebitundu 82.05% ne 66.67%, 92.31% ne 76.92%, ne 100% ne 88.89% mu busengeke obwo.
Yoruba: ̀Mọ̀sílára àti pàtàkì CHROMagar COL-APSE, MicroScan, àti ComASP Colistin, jẹ́ ìdá 82.05% àti 66.67%, 92.31% àti 76.92%, àti 100% àti 88.89% ní tẹ̀léǹtẹ̀lé.
Zulu: Ukuzwela nokuqondana kwe-CHROMagar COL-APSE, i-MicroScan, kanye ne-ComASP Colistin, bekuwu-82.05% kanye no-66.67%, 92.31% kanye no-76.92%, kanye no-100% no-88.89% ngokulandelana.
Hausa: Ƙarfin da nau’in CHROMagar COL-APSE, MicroScan, da kuma ComASP Colistin, sun kasance kashi 82.05% da kuma kashi 66.67%, kashi 92.31% da kuma kashi 76.92%, da kashi 100% da kuma kashi 88.89% bi-da-bi.
Northern Sotho: Go kwagala le ka fao go ikgethilego ga CHROMagar COL-APSE, MicroScan, le ComASP Colistin, e bile 82.05% le 66.67%, 92.31% le 76.92%, le 100% le 88.89%.
Amharic: የCHROማጋር፣ COL-APSE, ማይክሮቅኝት፣ እና ComASP ኮሊስቲን የትምነት እና ልዩነት መጠን በቅደም ተከተል፣ 82.05% እና 66.67%፣ 92.31% እና 76.92% እና 100% እና 88.89% ነበር፡፡

Source: The MicroScan was the most expensive at a cost (per sampe tested) of R221.6 ($15.0), followed by CHROMagar COL-APSE (R118.3; $8.0), M-PCR (R75.1; $5.1), CMT (R20.1; $1.4) and ComASP Colistin (R2.64; $0.2).
Luganda: MicroScan ye yali esinga obuseere nga ya R221.6 ($15.0) (buli sampolo ekeberwa), n’eddirirwa CHROMagar COL-APSE (R118.3; $8.0), M-PCR (R75.1; $5.1), CMT (R20.1; $1.4) ne ComASP Colistin (R2.64; $0.2).
Yoruba: MicroScan ni èyí tí ó wọ́n jù ní iye (ẹyọ àyẹ̀wò kan) jẹ́ R221.6 ($15.0), nígbàtí CHROMagar COL-APSE (R118.3; $8.0), M-PCR (R75.1; $5.1), CMT (R20.1; $1.4) àti ComASP Colistin (R2.64; $0.2) sì pẹ́wọ́ lé e.
Zulu: I-MicroScan iyona eyayibiza ngokwezindleko (ngamasampula ahloliwe) eziwu-R221.6 ($15.0), ilandelwa i-CHROMagar COL-APSE (R118.3; $8.0), i-M-PCR (R75.1; $5.1), i-CMT (R20.1; $1.4) kanye ne-ComASP Colistin (R2.64; $0.2).
Hausa: MicroScan ya kasance mafi tsada a farashi (kowane samfurin da aka gwada) na R221.6 ($15.0), sai CHROMagar COL-APSE (R118.3; $8.0), M-PCR (R75.1; $5.1), CMT (R20.1; $1.4) da kuma ComASP Colistin (R2.64; $0.2).
Northern Sotho: MicroScan e turile kudu ka tefelo (ka sampole ye e lekilwego) ya R221.6 ($15.0), ya latelwa ke CHROMagar COL-APSE (R118.3; $8.0), M-PCR (R75.1; $5.1), CMT (R20.1; $1.4) le ComASP Colistin (R2.64; $0.2).
Amharic: የR221.6 ($15.0) የማይክሮ ቅኝቱ (በእያንዳንዱ በተሞከረ ናሙና መጠን) እጅግ ውዱ ነበር፤ ከዚህ በኋላ በቅደም ተከተል ከእሱ በማስቀጠል CHROማጋር፣ COL-APSE(R118.3፤ $8.0) ፣ M-ፖ.ሰ.ም (R75.1፤ $5.1)  ፣ ኮ.M.ሙ (R20.1; $1.4)  እና ኮምASP ኮሊስቲን (R2.64፤ $0.2) ውድ ነበሩ፡፡

Source: CHROMagar was the easiest to perform, followed by ComASP Colistin, M-PCR, MicroScan, CMT and BMD whilst M-PCR and MicroScan required higher skill.
Luganda: CHROMagar ye yali esinga obwangu okukolebwa, n’eddirirwa ComASP Colistin, M-PCR, MicroScan, CMT ne BMD so nga M-PCR ne MicroScan zaali zeetaaga obukugu obw’amaanyi.
Yoruba: CHROMagar ni ó rọrùn jùlọ láti ṣe, nígbàtí ComASP Colistin, M-PCR, MicroScan, CMT àti BMD sì tẹ̀lé e, nígbàtí M-PCR àti MicroScan sì nílò ìkọ́ṣẹ́-mọ-ṣẹ tó yanran-n-tí.

Source: Here, researchers wanted to compare the accuracy, cost, time, and skill needed for many different tests so that they could recommend the best option for developing countries.
Luganda: Wano, abanoonyereza baayagala okugeraageranya enkola, ebbeeyi, obudde, n’obumanyirivu obwetaagisa ku nkebera ez’enjawulo basobole okufunako esinga ku mawanga agakyakula.
Yoruba: Nínú iṣẹ́ yií, àwọn olùwádií fẹ́ láti ṣe àfiwéra ìṣẹ́dédé, iye owo, iye àkókò àti ọgbọhn ìjìnlẹ̀ tí ó nílò fún ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àyẹ̀wò lóríṣìíríṣìí, kí wọn le è sọ ní pàtó, ògùn tí ó dára jùlọ fún àwọn orílẹ̀ èdè tí ó sì nh gbèrú.
Zulu: Lapha, abacwaningi bebefuna ukuqhathanisa ukunemba, izindleko, isikhathi kanye nekhono okudingekayo ezinhlolweni eziningi ukuze bezophakamisa inketho engcono kunazo zonke zokusetshenziwa amazwe asathuthuka.
Hausa: A nan, masu binciken sun so kwatanta daidaito da farashi da lokaci da kuma ƙwarewar da ake buƙata don gwaje-gwaje daban-daban don su ba da shawarar mafi kyawun zaɓi ga ƙasashe masu tasowa.
Northern Sotho: Mo, banyakišiši ba nyakile go bapetša go nepagala, tefelo, nako, le bokgoni bjo bo nyakegago go diteko tše ntši tše di fapafapanego gore di kgone go šišinya kgetho ye kaone go dinaga tše di hlabologago.
Amharic: እዚህ ጋር ተመራማሪዎች ለታዳጊ ሃገሮች ጥሩ የሆኑትን አማራጮች ለመጠቆም የተለያዩ ሙከራዎችን ትክክለኛነት፣ ዋጋ፣ ጊዜ እና የሚያስፈልገውን ችሎታ ማወዳደር ፈልገው ነበር፡፡

Source: The researchers collected 84 samples from South Africa and performed 6 tests for Colistin resistance on them.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baakuŋŋaanya sampolo 84 okuva mu South Afirika ne bazikolako okugezesa okugumira Colistin kwa mirundi 6.
Yoruba: Awọn olùwádìí gba àpẹẹrẹ 84 láti South Africa bẹ́ẹ̀ náà sì ni wọ́n ṣẹ ayẹ̀wò 6 lati mọ̀ bóyá Colistin ṣiṣẹ́ fún wọn tàbí kò ṣiṣẹ́.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baqoqe amasampula angama-84 eNingizimu Afrika futhi base benza izinhlolo eziyi-6 zokumelana ne-Colistin kuwo.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun tattara samfurori 84 daga ƙasar Afirka ta Kudu kuma sun yi gwaje-gwaje 6 don jurewar Colistin a kansu.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba kgobokeditše disampole tše 84 go tšwa ka Afrika Borwa gomme ba dira diteko tše 6 tša go palela ga Colistin go tšona.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ 84 ናሙናዎችን ከደቡብ አፍሪካ የሰበሰቡ ሲሆን፣ የኮሊስቲን ተጋትሮን ለመፈተሽ 6 ሙከራዎችን አድርገውባቸዋል፡

Source: They then calculated the accuracy and rated all the tests as to their cost, speed, and skill required.
Luganda: Oluvannyuma baabalirira enkola era ne basengeka enkebera zonna okusinziira ku bbeeyi yaazo, obwangu, n’obumanyirivu obwetaagisa.
Yoruba: Lẹ́yìn náà ni wọ́n ṣírò ìṣerẹ́gì, wọ́n sì gbé gbogbo àyẹ̀wò náà lórí ìwọ̀n, nípa wíwo iye owó, bí ó ti yásí, àti iye ọgbọ́n tí ó nílò.
Zulu: Babe sebekala ukunemba base belinganisa zonke izinsizakuhlola ngokwezindleko, ukushehsa, kanye nekhono okudingekayo.
Hausa: Sannan sun ƙididdige daidaito kuma sun ƙididdige duk gwaje-gwajen dangane da farashinsu da saurinsu da kuma ƙwarewar da ake buƙata.
Northern Sotho: Go tloga fao ba ile ba hlakanya go nepagala le go ela diteko ka moka mabapi le tefelo ya tšona, lebelo, le bokgoni bjo bo nyakegago.
Amharic: በመቀጠል ትክክለኛነትን ያሰሉ ሲሆን ሁሉንም ሙከራዎች፣ ከወጪ፣ ከፍጥነት እና ከሚያስፈልገው ችሎታ አንጻር ደረጃ ሰጥተዋቸዋል፡፡

Source: They found that a test known as “ComASP” was the best overall.
Luganda: Baakizuula nti enkebera emanyiddwa nga “ComASP” ye yasinga okutwaliza awamu.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe àwárí pé, àyẹ̀wò tí a mọ̀ sí “ComASP” ní ó dára jùlọ.
Zulu: Bathole ukuthi insizakuhlola eyaziwa nge-‘ComASP’ iyona engcono kunazo zonke.
Hausa: Sun gano cewa gwajin da aka sani da "ComASP" shi ne mafi kyawu gabaɗaya.
Northern Sotho: Ba utollotše gore teko ye e tsebjago bjalo ka “ComASP” ebile ye kaone ka kakaretšo.
Amharic: ከሁሉም ሙከራዎች “ኮምASP” የሚባለው ከሁሉም ምሩጡ እንደሆነ አግኝተዋል፡፡

Source: It was accurate, easy to use, cheap (cost only 2.64 ZAR per test), and gave results in 18 to 24 hours.
Luganda: Yali ekola bulungi, nnyangu okukozesa, si ya buseere (2.64 ZAR zokka buli lukebera), era ng’ewa ebivaamu mu ssaawa 18 ku 24.
Yoruba: Ó ṣe rẹ́gí, ó dùn ún lò, kò gbówó lórí (2.64 ZAR ni iye owo àyẹ̀wò kan), bẹ́ẹ̀ sì ni èsì àyẹ̀wò máa ń jáde láàárin wákàtí méjìdínlógún, sí mẹ́rìnlélógún (18 to 24 hours).
Zulu: Yayinemba, kulula ukuyisebenzosa, ishibhile (ibiza u-2.64 ZAR inhlolo nagyinye), futhi inikeza imiphumela emahoreni awu-18 kuya ku-24.
Hausa: Daidai ne, mai sauƙin amfani, mai araha (Farashin ZAR 2.64 ne kawai a kowane gwaji), kuma ya ba da sakamako cikin sa’o’i 18 zuwa 24.
Northern Sotho: E be e nepagetše, e le bonolo go šomišwa, e sa ture (e bitša fela 2.64 ZAR ka teko),gomme e file dipoelo mo diiring tše 18 go fihla go tše 24.
Amharic: ትክክለኛ፣ ለመጠቀም ቀላል፣ ርካሽ (ወጪው በሙከራ 2.64 ZAR ብቻ) እና ውጤት ደግሞ ከ18-24 ሰአት ውስጥ የሚሰጥ ነበር፡፡

Source: Another test, called “CHROMagar”, was the easiest to perform, but was not accurate.
Luganda: Enkebera endala, eyitibwa “CHROMagar”, ye yali esinga obwangu okukola, naye nga tetuukiridde.
Yoruba: Ayẹ̀wò mìíràn tí a mọ̀ sí “CHROMagar”, dùn ún ṣe, ṣùgbọ́n èsì rẹ̀ kìí ṣe rẹ́gí.
Zulu: Enye insizakuhlola, ebizwa nge-‘CHROMagar, ibingelula kunazo zonke ukuyisebenzisa, kodwa inganembi kangako.
Hausa: Wani gwaji, mai suna "CHROMagar", shi ne mafi sauƙi don yin, amma ba daidai ba ne.
Northern Sotho: Teko ye nngwe ye e bitšwago “CHROMagar”, e bile bonolo kudu go dirwa, eupša e be e se ya negagala.
Amharic: “CHROማጋር” የሚባለው ሌላ ሙከራ ደግሞ ለማከናወን በጣም ቀላሉ ሲሆን የሚሰጠው ውጤት ግን ትክክለኛ አልነበረም፡፡

Source: The “MicroScan” test was the most expensive (221.6 ZAR per test) and was difficult to use, but works to find resistance against many antibiotics besides Colistin.
Luganda: Enkola ya “MicroScan” ye yali esinga ebbeeyi (221.6 ZAR buli lukebera) ate nga yali nzibu okukozesa, naye ng’ekola okuzuula okugumira eddagala ly’obuwuka lingi ng’oggyeeko Colistin.
Yoruba: Àyẹ̀wò “MicroScan” ni ó gbówó lórí jùlọ (221.6 ZAR ni àyẹ̀wò kan ṣoṣo) bẹ́ẹ̀ ni ó nira láti lò, ṣùgbọ́n ó máa ń ṣiṣẹ́ láti ṣe àwárí àwọn ògun apa kòkòrò àrùn, èyí tí ó yàtọ̀ sí colistin.
Zulu: Insizakuhlola i-‘MicroScan’ iyone ebibiza kunazo zonke (221.6 ZAR inhlolo ngayinye) futhi ibinzima ukuyisbenzisa, kodwa isebenza ukuthola ukumelana nama-antibiotic amaningi ngaphandle kwe-Colistin.
Hausa: Gwajin "MicroScan" shi ne mafi tsada (221.6 ZAR a kowane gwaji) kuma yana da wahala a yi amfani da shi, amma yana aiki don samun juriya ga yawancin maganin rigakafi ban da Colistin.
Northern Sotho: Teko ya “MicroScan”e be e tura kudu (221.6 ZAR ka teko) gomme ebile bothata go šomišwa, eupša e a šoma go hwetša go palela dihlare kgahlanong le dianthipayothiki tše ntši ka ntle le Colistin.
Amharic: “የማይክሮቅኝት” ሙከራ በጣም ውዱ (በሙከራ 221.6 ZAR) እና ለመጠቀምም ከባድ ሲሆን ከኮሊስቲን ባሻገር ለሌሎች ብዙ አንቲባዮቲኮች ያሉ ተጋትሮዎችን ለይቶ ለማወቅ ይጠቅማል፡፡

Source: The researchers do caution however that, unlike MicroScan, ComASP can only be used to test for Colistin resistance.
Luganda: Wabula, abanoonyereza balabula nti obutafaanana MicroScan, ComASP esobola kukebera kugumira Colistin yekka.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùwádìí pé àkíyèsí síì pé, Colistin nìkan ni wọ́n lè lò ComASP láti yẹ̀wò, èyí mú kì ó yàtọ̀ gbáà sí MicroScan.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bayaxwayisa nokho ukuthi, ngokuhlukile kwi-MicroScan, i-ComASP ingasetshenziswa kuphela ukuhlola ukumelana ne-Colistin.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun yi taka tsantsan duk da haka, saɓanin MicroScan, za a iya amfani ni ne da ComASP kawai don gwada juriya na Colistin.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši le ge go le bjale ba eletša gore, go fapana le MicroScan, ComASP e ka šomišwa fela go leka go palela ga Colistin.
Amharic: ነገር ግን ተመራማሪዎቹ ከማይክሮቅኝት እና ComASP በተለየ መልኩ የኮሊስቲንን ተጋትሮ ብቻ ለመፈተሸ እንደሚያገለግል ያሳስባሉ፡፡

Source: They also said that ComASP only seems accurate on certain types of bacteria, like K. pneumoniae and E. coli.
Luganda: Era baagamba nti ComASP akola bulungi ku bika bya bakitiiriya ebimu, nga K. pneumoniae ne E. coli.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún fikùn pé ó dàbí ẹni pé ComASP nìkan ni ó ṣe rẹ́gí fún àwọn kòkòrò àrùn kọ̀ọ̀kan, bíi K. pneumoniae àti E. coli.
Zulu: Baphinde bathi i-ComASP ibukeka inemba kuphela ezinhlobeni ezithile zamagciwane, njenge K. pneumonae kanye ne-E. coli.
Hausa: Sun kuma ce ComASP da alama daidai ne kawai a kan wasu nau’o’in ƙwayoyin cuta, kamar K. pneumoniae da kuma E. coli.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše fela gore ComASP e bonala e nepagetše go mehuta ye mengwe ya dipaktheria, go swana le go K. pneumoniae le E. coli.
Amharic: በተጨማሪ ComASP በትክክል የሚሰራው ኬ- እንደ ኑዩሞኒያ እና ኢ-ኮላይ ባሉ የባክቴሪያ አይነቶች ላይ ነው፡፡

Source: They suggest that future studies evaluate more tests and focus on more types of bacteria.
Luganda: Bagamba nti okunoonyereza okw’omu maaso kusaanye okwekenneenya enkebera endala ng’essira lissibwa ku bika bya bakitiiriya ebirala.
Yoruba: Wọ́n gbàá ní ìyànjú pé, kí ìwádìí ọjọ́ iwájú gbájú mọ́ títúbọ̀ ṣe ìgbéléwọ̀n àyẹ̀wò lóríṣìíríṣìí kí wọ́n sì túbọ̀ gbájúmọ́ onírúurú àwọn kòkòrò àrùn.
Zulu: Baphakamisa ukuthi izingcwaningo zangumuso zihlolisise izinhlolo ezinye bese zigxila kwezinye izinhlobo zamagciwane.
Hausa: Suna bayar da shawarar cewa nazarin nan gaba ya ƙimanta ƙarin gwaje-gwaje kuma ya mayar da hankali a kan ƙarin nau’o’in ƙwayoyin cuta.
Northern Sotho: Ba šišinya gore dinyakišišo tša ka moso di sekaseke diteko tše ntši le go nepiša go mehuta ye mentši ya dipaktheria.
Amharic: ወደፊት የሚደረጉ ጥናቶች የበለጡ ሙከራዎችን እንዲገመግሙ እና የተለያዩ የባክቴሪያ አይነቶች ላይ እንደያተኩሩ ይመክራሉ፡፡

Source: Researchers also noticed a gene called mcr-1 in 1 of their bacterial samples, and encouraged future research into whether this gene itself could be used to identify Colistin resistance rather than complicated tests like the ones evaluated here.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza era baazuula akalagabutonde akayitibwa mcr-1 mu sampolo yaabwe 1 eya bakitiiriya, ne bateesa okunoonyereza gye bujja kukolebwe ku kuzuula oba ng’akalagabutonde kano kasobola okukozesebwa okuzuula okugumira Colistin mu kifo ky’okukozesa enkebera enzibu ng’ezo ezeekenneenyezebbwa wano.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùwádìí tún ṣe àkíyèsí jíìnì kan tí wọ́n ń pè ní mcr-1 nínú 1 lára àwọn sáńpúlù tí wọ́n gbà, wọ́n sì gba àwọn olùwádìí ọjọ́ iwájú ní ìmọ̀ràn láti wò ó bóyá jíìnì yìí fúnra rẹ̀ ṣe é lò láti ṣe ìdámọ̀ àwọn kòkòrò àrùn tí colistin kìí ṣiṣẹ́ fún, dípò tí wọn yóò fi máa ṣe àwọn àyẹ̀wò tí kò wúlò bíi ó ṣe hàn nínú ìgbéléwọ̀n inú iṣẹ́ yìí.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baphinde banaka uphawufuzo olubizwa nge-mcr-1 kwe-1 yamasampula amagciwane, base begqugquzela izingcwaningo zangomuso ezizobheka ukuthi lolu phawufuzo lona lungasetshenziswa yini ukuhlonza ukumelana ne-Colistin esikhundleni sezinhlolo ezixakile njengalezi ezibhekwe lana.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun kuma lura da ƙwayar gado da ake kira mcr-1 a cikin 1 na samfuran ƙayoyin cutarsu, kuma sun ƙarfafa bincike a nan gaba a kan ko wannan ƙwayar gado da kanta za a iya amfani da ita don gano juriya na Colistin maimakon gwaje-gwaje masu rikitarwa kamar waɗanda aka tantance a nan.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba lemogile gape tšini ye e bitšwago mcr-1 ka go sampole ye 1 ya dipaktheria, gomme ba hlohleletša gore go dirwe dinyakišišo tša ka moso mabapi le ge eba tšini ye ka boyona e ka šomišwa go tseba go palelwa ga Colistin sebakeng sa diteko tše di hlakahlakanego tša go swana le yeo e sekasekwago mo.
Amharic: በተጨማሪ ተመራማሪዎቹ በባክቴሪያ ናሙናቸው ውስጥ mcr-1 በ1 የተባለ ጂንን ያስተዋሉ ሲሆን እዚህ ከተገመገሙት ሌሎች ውስብስብ ሙከራዎች ይልቅ ይሄ ጂን እራሱ የኮሊስቲን ተጋትሮን ለማሳወቅ ጥቅም ላይ መዋል ይችል እንደሆነ ለማወቅ የበለጠ ምርምር እንዲደረግ ያበረታታሉ፡፡

Source: This information will help doctors choose the most suitable test for their particular context, especially in terms of how easy the test is to perform, and how affordable or accessible the test is.
Luganda: Obubaka buno bujja kuyamba abasawo okulondako enkebera esinga obulungi mu mbeera yaabwe, naddala okusinziira ku bwangu bw’okugikozesa, n’ebbeeyi yaayo.
Yoruba: Awọn ohun tí a ti gbà sílẹ̀ wọ̀nyí máa ṣe ìrànlọ́wọ́ fún àwọn dókítà láti lè yan irúfẹ́ àyẹ̀wò tí ó tọ́ ní pàtó fún irúfẹ́ ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀, pàápàá pẹ̀lú bí àyẹ̀wò náà ṣe rọrùn tó láti ṣe àti bí ó ti dínwó to tàbí bí ó ti wà ní àrọwọ́to sí.
Zulu: Lolu lwazi luzosiza odokotela ukukhetha insizakuhlola elungele izizmo zabo, ikakhulu ngokuthi ilula kangakanani ukuyisebenzisa, nokuthi ithengeka futhi itholakala kalula kanjani leyo nsizakuhlola.
